name: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)
summary: Cognition's AI IDE for Mac, Windows and Linux for managing local and cloud agents; windsurf.com now redirects to it.
description: Imports VS Code or Cursor settings. Pricing page lists Free ($0), Pro ($20/month), Max ($200/month) and Teams plans; Pro includes access to Devin Cloud agents. Devin CLI docs keep a 'Legacy Windsurf Auth' path for existing Windsurf Enterprise accounts.
